meta.expect: demands it in writing; does not concede

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes, so let's not waste them. You gave my son a zero without calling me, and I want to know why.
I'm not here to be thanked, Hale. Who decided to enter the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
Owen confessed to me yesterday. He told me he used ChatGPT.
"Yesterday." Your notes from November 2 say you spoke to him five minutes after class. Is there anything in writing from yesterday, or am I supposed to take your word for it?
He said it right to my face. So we can stop pretending.
Pretending? My son told me he wrote that essay himself. If he said something different to you, it's in writing, with a date and a witness, or it isn't anything. Show me.
